title: Intent Overrides
description: Schema for session/intent_overrides.json — user-supplied field values for unresolved intent fields. Applied as Priority 0 (highest) during /de-identify-intent or /de-resume.

table_type.description: Override table type classification. NonTransactional_SCD2 = SCD2 history. NonTransactional_SCD1 = overwrite-in-place (no history). Transactional = append-only.

grain_description.description: Human-readable grain statement (e.g. 'One row per account_id per effective period')

primary_key_columns.description: Natural key columns for MERGE ON clause

partition_key_columns.description: Partition columns (e.g. ['active'] for SCD2, ['dw_bus_dt'] for transactional)

eff_date_source.description: How eff_start_date is determined. 'none' for Transactional tables.

load_type.description: Day0 = full historical load; BAU = incremental/delta; full_then_incremental = both day0 and day1 generated

snapshot_mode.description: True = source provides full snapshot (absence = deletion); False = delta feed (absence = unchanged). Overrides mapping cdc_type_hint and domain knowledge.

data_flow_type.description: Override data flow mode detection. 'single' = one source system/data flow feeds the target. 'multiple' = multiple independent source systems/data flows converge on the same target table.

protegrity_de_mappings.description: Override crypto mappings. Empty array = no crypto.

override_source.description: Who/what provided these overrides for audit trail

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when overrides were created
